title: Deploy prepared systemd units for Oracle lane fleet (closes heartbeat-cgroup-kill gap)
description:
Systemd unit files are already written in this workspace's `systemd/` directory and reviewed, but **not installed**. This issue requests the human/agent with `sudo` on `paperclip-prod` to deploy them via the existing helper script.

## Why this is needed

The 5-min bash keep-alive (BUY-30854) cannot keep lanes alive during 20-30 min heartbeat-cgroup-kill windows. Latest diagnostic on [BUY-31847](/BUY/issues/BUY-31847) showed:

- Heartbeat gaps of 20-30 min observed in the routine cadence log
- Per-tick restart gap is sub-second, but inter-tick gap (when no heartbeat is firing) leaves lanes dark
- Throughput is currently fine (389k products/hr, 2.6x the 150k target), but only because lanes happen to stay alive long enough

Systemd `Restart=always` + `RestartSec=15` closes the gap to ~15 seconds.

## Deploy command

```bash
sudo bash /paperclip/instances/default/projects/177bc805-e3c8-4336-84cb-8e1e482d5a17/18221361-973a-493e-9e19-4c43b7a1c6eb/_default/scripts/deploy-systemd-units.sh
```

The script:
1. Copies the 5 unit files to `/etc/systemd/system/`
2. Runs `systemctl daemon-reload`
3. Enables and starts each unit
4. Prints `systemctl status` for verification

## Units to deploy

1. `paperclip-buy30331-sustained-loop.service` — Google Shopping sustained ingest
2. `paperclip-buy30590-deep-page-loop.service` — Shopify deep pagination
3. `paperclip-buy30727-lane-supervisor.service` — CC-MAIN worker supervisor (skipped when `data/buy30727-supervisor.stopped` exists per BUY-31452)
4. `paperclip-loop-supervisor.service` — Meta-supervisor
5. `paperclip-lane-keep-alive.service` — Secondary watchdog

## Pre-flight checks

- All 5 unit files exist at `systemd/` in the workspace
- Existing paperclip units (`paperclip-kill-watcher`, `paperclip-sigkill-trap`) are already installed and running — same deployment pattern
- All `WorkingDirectory` and `ExecStart` paths in the units use the absolute workspace path
- The supervisor unit has `ConditionPathExists=!data/buy30727-supervisor.stopped` so the BUY-31452 stop marker still works
- `paperclip` user has no `sudo` NOPASSWD; this requires an Ops human/agent with root

## Post-deploy verification

After deployment, expected behavior:

```bash
systemctl status paperclip-buy30331-sustained-loop paperclip-buy30590-deep-page-loop
# Both should show Active: active (running) and Restart=always
```

Within 5 minutes, the existing heartbeat-spawned processes should exit (cgroup-killed at heartbeat end) and systemd-managed processes should take over with the same `pid=`s in `logs/supervised-buy3*.log` and the actual service in systemd's cgroup.

## Acceptance

- All 5 units show `Active: active (running)` after deploy
- `systemctl show paperclip-buy30590-deep-page-loop | grep Restart` shows `Restart=always`
- A simulated kill (`kill -9 $(pgrep -f buy30590-deep-page-loop)`) is recovered within 15-30 seconds (visible in `journalctl -u paperclip-buy30590-deep-page-loop -n 20`)
- Heartbeat log shows no DEAD ticks for 24 hours
- Hourly throughput remains >= 300k products/hr
